headline: US president's son-in-law announced another round of Ukraine negotiations
summary: US special envoy Jared Kushner announced a further round of negotiations on a new security architecture for Europe. The input gives no date or venue.
why: Progress or setbacks in Ukraine negotiations influence European energy, defence spending and regional risk premiums, which matter for investors in those markets.
original_headline: Зять президента США анонсировал очередной раунд переговоров по Украине
